newsitem.title: UK: Appleby accepts cash offer from BWG (NI).
newsitem.headline: Appleby accepts cash offer from BWG (NI).

text.p: Food distribution firm Appleby Westward Group Plc said on Friday that it had received and accepted an offer from Irish company BWG (NI) for its total issued ordinary share capital.
BWG is offering 1.71 stg for each Appleby Westward share valuing its share capital at 9.5 million stg, a premium of 32.6 percent.
Appleby said its directors, their immediate families and associated trusts had irrevocably accepted the offer in respect of 4,237,850 shares, representing 76 percent of its share capital.
